nativeFixture.independentConsumerAuthorReview: The private IUnknown ABI uses one fixed IID and matching HRESULT/noexcept signatures; a real IInspectable object is stored in the property bag. Borrowed inputs are AddRef'd, visual/site/template objects stay weak, tickets contain generation only, first thread ownership uses CAS, and copied entries plus identity/generation checks reject reentrant or stale lifetimes. The owned subclass is removed on WM_NCDESTROY. This was a source review, not compiled or executed verification.

dependencyPaths.relationship: Calls the child in its existing scope after four strict drag scenarios; retains process.Handle, ownedProcessId, ownedProcessStartTime, AppUserModelId and NativeWindow methods. No parent edit.

Existing Resolve-NativeDragTracePath validates AppUserModelId, resolves one PackageFamilyName and derives the exact LocalState directory. The new consumer discards only the old drag filename and forms the fixed PID/creation probe prefix.
Separate native source review; observation-only fixed protocol. Native execution remains unverified.

design.reason: The independently retained 782 and combined 9a runs completed their bounded Raw UIA search with zero qualifying Icon peers. That does not establish an absent rendered icon or a layout defect. The native fixture observes actual template visuals instead.
design.binding: Existing held process handle, exact PID and creation FILETIME, parent UTC start time, retained owner HWND/native thread/runtime ID, sourceRevision, fresh native GUID session and exact request sequence/phase. Native generation/role/component identities must remain unchanged.
design.io: Fixed LocalState filenames derived via the existing owned AUMID resolver. Requests use CREATE_NEW temp files, complete flush/close and a non-replacing move. Ready/responses require disk/non-reparse/non-directory handles, exact resolved path, no shared write/delete, complete bounded stable reads and strict UTF-8. Each retained exclusive copy is read back and hash/byte-count compared.
design.schema: Duplicate/case-aliased keys and unsupported grammar are rejected before PS5.1 ConvertFrom-Json. The exact typed schema rejects missing/extra/mismatched headers, malformed or incomplete counts, stale generations and invalid Int32 rectangles. Unavailable native failures are stored as a fixed enum or null; raw response bytes remain separate.
design.timing: One initial phase-1 response window is bounded to ten seconds. The original RTL action and status wait remain in order. Every phase-2 and final observation uses the same original ten-second deadline, with the original 100 ms outer poll. Missing-file checks sleep 10 ms; no sequence is retried or replayed.
design.geometry: Strict finite positive checked-edge RectInt32 physical screen rectangles, containing owner/navigation/toggle/icon bounds, native sequential stability and bracketed same-owner geometry. The exact old left-half to right-half and stable containing-rectangle predicate is retained.
design.preservation: 24 original action statements and the 4,455-byte later drawer/contrast/catch/finally/restoration/result tail are exact, apart from the secondary summary-call name. Borrowed GET contrast and owned SET allocation/free are unchanged. No compact-width mutation, UIA Icon inference, process search, provider reacquisition, focus/activation/input change, workflow edit, timeout extension or acceptance relaxation.
design.reporting: The same fixed console markers now project captured native state only. Full UTF-8 envelope including its final newline is capped at 8 KiB; overflow is explicit, errors stay secondary. All ready/request/response captures use fixed output filenames, exact original bytes and hashes. Console omits raw session GUID, paths, exception text and arbitrary native data.

limits: Native C++ compilation, actual PowerShell parsing, C# Add-Type compilation, file/message exchange and physical geometry remain unverified at this source checkpoint.
Retry-window deadlines do not cancel synchronous UIA or filesystem calls. Matching sequential rectangles do not prove atomicity or render completion.
The fixed native protocol is private acceptance instrumentation, not a public package API, access-control boundary or public accessibility/VoiceOver/Narrator completeness claim.
No accepted final native archive, eligible unelevated host, release gate or physical user interaction is established by source/model results.
